WITH type_avg AS (
    SELECT e."EquipType", AVG(om."MAINT_COST_usd") as avg_maint 
    FROM "Equipment" e 
    JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = om."equipRef" 
    GROUP BY e."EquipType"
),
eer_calc AS (
    SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE", e."EquipType", 
           (CAST(et.type_indices->>'performance_score' AS numeric) + e."RELIAB_IDX") / 2.0 * (1 - CAST(et.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx' AS numeric) / 100) as EER
    FROM "Equipment" e 
    JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON e."EquipType" = et."EquipType"
)
SELECT ec."EQUIP_CODE", ec."EquipType", ec.EER, ta.avg_maint, om."MAINT_COST_usd"
FROM eer_calc ec
JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON ec."EQUIP_CODE" = om."equipRef"
JOIN type_avg ta ON ec."EquipType" = ta."EquipType"
WHERE ec.EER < 40 AND om."MAINT_COST_usd" > ta.avg_maint
